answer: Not equipment (2zone temp flat ~1150C, R2 constant +5C offset; run hours noisy w/o step; downtime sporadic, no persistent post-June rise). Two coincident causes from ~week 14-15 (June): (1) seasonal humidity: weekly mean outside humidity rose from ~50-58% to 70-87%, and yield falls with humidity in all reactors (~28 at 50% to ~22 at 80%); (2) catalyst lot change to FC-2606/2607/2608: at the same humidity (60-80%) these lots yield ~3-5 g/g-cat less than FC-2602..2605 in R1/R2/R4 (about 27-28 -> 23-25) and R3 is worst (about 27-28 -> 20-22, extra ~3 drop; R3 weekly mean ~20 vs 23-25 for others). Humidity and lot are confounded in time, so the split cannot be fully separated; the R3 shortfall is mainly lot x R3 interaction (R3 also has most catalyst-feed downtime, ~1890 min vs 1230-1570, but not time-matched).
